name: reputecast
label: ReputeCast
description: Start scenarios from ReputeCast events, and create contacts, tag them, record events and send transactional email from your other apps. ReputeCast is the open-source, self-hosted newsletter platform.

watchSubscribedContacts.label: Watch Subscribed Contacts
watchSubscribedContacts.description: Triggers when a contact subscribes to a list: through a form, an import, the API or the app.

watchUnsubscribedContacts.label: Watch Unsubscribed Contacts
watchUnsubscribedContacts.description: Triggers when a contact unsubscribes from a list.

watchUpdatedContacts.label: Watch Updated Contacts
watchUpdatedContacts.description: Triggers when a contact's names, fields, language, tags or lists change.

watchFormSubmissions.label: Watch Form Submissions
watchFormSubmissions.description: Triggers when a signup through a form is confirmed: at once for single opt-in, after the confirmation click for double opt-in.

watchSentCampaigns.label: Watch Sent Campaigns
watchSentCampaigns.description: Triggers when a campaign finishes sending, with its totals.

watchTransactionalBounces.label: Watch Transactional Bounces
watchTransactionalBounces.description: Triggers when a transactional email bounces.

createOrUpdateContact.label: Create or Update a Contact
createOrUpdateContact.description: Creates a contact, or updates the one with the same email, and adds them to lists with single or double opt-in.

addContactToList.label: Add a Contact to a List
addContactToList.description: Adds an existing contact to a list, with single or double opt-in.

addTagToContact.label: Add a Tag to a Contact
addTagToContact.description: Adds one or more tags to an existing contact.

recordEvent.label: Record an Event
recordEvent.description: Records an event for a contact, which starts the automations that listen for it.

sendTransactionalEmail.label: Send a Transactional Email
sendTransactionalEmail.description: Sends a published transactional template to one recipient, with its variables.
